posts.title: lsx on Unix 7
posts.description: I've been playing around with Unix 7 in simh for a few weeks and I wanted to share a little script to print directories in four columns with the same -F type indicator you would see in modern Unix. posts.description: I love the Tomy Tutor. I didn't have one as a kid, but I have several now. I was the point-person for a group buy on AtariAge to get a few multicarts sent from Europe.
